start.card:
A small college has 2 professors. It has six times as many students as professors.
Which equation says that? S means students and P means professors. Make a guess first.
start.title: Students and professors

afterGuess.card:
You picked S = 6P. Let's test it with real numbers.
Press the button to give each professor their students. Six times as many students means 6 students for each professor.
afterGuess.title: Students and professors

after.card:
With 6 professors there are 36 students. S = 6P still works; 6S = P still fails.
Takeaway: "six times as many students" means students = 6 × professors, so S = 6P. The 6 goes next to the smaller group, P.
after.title: Students and professors
